mobile_maia_reference.scope_note: Inspected pinned reference; do not assert this is the current Mobile Maia release.

ec_rule.brilliant: played root is first, best-versus-second mapped gap >10 percentage points, EC sacrifice true, mapped loss <=5
ec_rule.interesting: EC sacrifice outside unique-best branch and after cp >-200
ec_rule.sacrifice: nonterminal and M(before) > -M(after) +100; every legal root followed by capture-only material qsearch

mute_v2_rule.sacrifice: legal non-pawn non-king piece offer; no EC material fallback
mute_v2_rule.offer_test: Opponent best legal same-square capture exchange gain > max(0, mover material after minus before) +100. Capture/promotion gains are credited; either side can stop local exchange.
mute_v2_rule.routine_win_veto: another evaluated non-sacrificing root at >=+600 cp mover
mute_v2_rule.earlier_EC_sacrifice_labels: Clear EC !! or !? when legal-offer test fails; keep negative classifications; otherwise retained fallback labels apply.
mute_v2_rule.corroboration: whole current/prior or independent matching-quality nonshallower decision window; withheld is not an award
mute_v2_rule.known_limit: same-square offer test can miss recoup on another square; current two-PV relevance gate does not examine every safe alternative

baseline_state.score_mapping: W(cp)=100/(1+exp(-0.00368208*cp)); cp normalized to mover and clamped [-1000,1000]; mate win/loss mapped to +/-1000. This is a heuristic, not a calibrated outcome probability or Chess.com formula.

evidence_protocol.primary_positive: Fresh review explicitly Brilliant; gallery-only positives remain historical positives and are reported separately.
evidence_protocol.primary_negative: Fresh Game Review explicitly any non-Brilliant classification, with exact move identity and captured evidence. A missing gallery entry is UNKNOWN.
evidence_protocol.disagreement: Preserve both observations without overwriting. Exclude unresolved contradictory labels from primary fresh-label metrics or stratify by captured review configuration.
evidence_protocol.indexing: Do not trust ?move= alone. Verify displayed selected SAN against legal PGN replay, exact ply, side and full-move number. Source query index is retained separately.
evidence_protocol.game_history: Store one original full PGN per game, preserving headers, comments/clocks, starting FEN and side. Derive positions from legal replay. FEN alone is insufficient.
evidence_protocol.download_scope: Only documented public monthly account PGN archives for months needed by selected UI examples. No cookies/private callback endpoints; sequential request pacing and stop at deadline.
evidence_protocol.missing_metadata: Use explicit null/unknown/not_available; do not fabricate category membership, coach text, clocks or reviews.

sampling.positives: Four per account, prefer distinct games and available gallery category coverage. Record selection order and category before inspecting local rule outcomes.
sampling.negative_notes: Targets guide coverage, not mandatory quotas. Use fresh-review labels in selected games; report category shortages. Keep gallery category membership distinct from analyst-assigned mechanism. Avoid filling negatives with only obvious opening moves.
sampling.unknowns: A gallery omission is never labeled negative. An unreviewed nearby move stays unknown.
sampling.known_development_examples: Prior nine examples and owner cases below have already influenced policy discussion; do not present them as independent test evidence.

holdout.player_test: Every selected game with Hikaru as White or Black is player_holdout, even if selected through another account.
holdout.remaining_game_partition: For non-Hikaru games, compute the full SHA256(game_id) hexadecimal digest as an integer; integer modulo 5 equal to 0 -> game_holdout, otherwise development. This exactly matches corpus.py and the frozen manifest.
holdout.game_atomicity: All observations, both sides, alternate labels and repeated gallery entries from a game stay in one partition. Repeated FENs across games are reported as potential dependence.
holdout.pilot_no_tuning: Freeze baselines and budgets now. Report feasibility and descriptive baseline outputs only. Do not select thresholds from held-out outcomes. A later study needs an agreed analysis plan and enough independent games.
holdout.small_sample_note: Forty selected moves and only five strong accounts cannot establish a stable per-player/category error rate or beginner behavior.

fixed_engine_plan.baseline_positions: preceding, before, after each labeled move; use legal PGN history. Search forward. Complete exact distinct legal two-PV iterations per nonterminal position; terminal score finite and explicitly flagged.
fixed_engine_plan.session: Fresh ucinewgame/isready session boundary per game and budget, clear hash; keep hash warm only within that forward game/window. Never mix scores across engines, budgets or snapshot depths.
fixed_engine_plan.stronger_subset: Predeclared stronger-subset.json contains exactly Hansen Qxe4 game184403311373 ply59 (fresh Best false positive), KNVB Bxd5+ game186066679548 ply103 (fresh Brilliant false negative), nelsi Qxd6+ game186405804254 ply51 (fresh Brilliant false negative), reason budget_sensitivity_of_mismatch. No extra stronger cases or tuning in this pilot.
fixed_engine_plan.two_reports: Report pure-rule eligibility separately from confirmation-aware awards. Never synthesize prior iterations by copying current snapshots as evidence of real confirmation.
fixed_engine_plan.no_performance_claim: Node budgets make engine evidence comparable; they are not the deployed browser Fast/Balanced/Thorough settings and do not reproduce Chess.com analysis.

metrics.primary_denominator: Only identity-validated fresh-review positives and confirmed fresh non-brilliants, with usable full-PGN and local evidence. Missing/ambiguous rows reported separately.
report: withheld rate separate from semantic rejection
exact numerator and denominator for every rate
eligibility and confirmed-award confusion matrices separately
complete label disagreements, not only successes
metrics.empty_cells: Report n/a and counts, not zero error.
metrics.interpretation: Descriptive feasibility only; no claim of generalization, exhaustive formula recovery or measured production award rate.

owner_regression_controls.name: L1lChap-nelsi 14...Ndxe5
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: same-square loss on e5 is recouped on d3; two knights for knight+bishop plus pawn

owner_regression_controls.name: 41.Qf5+
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: EC material probe treats deferred optional promotion gain as sacrifice; no legal immediate nonpawn capture after check

owner_regression_controls.name: 17...Bf5
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: defended tactic; capture-only probe misses quiet Rd1+

deliverable_boundary.pilot_report: Actual verified counts, missing metadata, indexing/category/PGN feasibility, observed elapsed collection and analysis cost, recommended full-study budget based on throughput. Explicitly report if 20+20 target is not achieved within cap.
deliverable_boundary.not_authorized: No scale-up to all 3519 entries, no new rule tuning/deployment, no new shared data platform or general collection framework.

runtime_setup.python: Python 3 with python-chess available; script also recognizes this session’s temporary dependency directory as a fallback. Install dependencies yourself in an isolated environment; no package/deployment framework is supplied.
runtime_setup.engine: Stockfish18 binary is currently explicitly pinned at /opt/homebrew/bin/stockfish with recorded SHA256. Moving/changing the binary path requires a new collector artifact/output; cached evidence is reused only when engine hash and collector script hash agree.
runtime_setup.typescript: Node24 and tsx loader, plus chessops0.15.1. Pinned classifier/core source files and import shim are relative paths. Point reference/current-v2/node_modules at an existing compatible node_modules directory; the session symlink is replaceable and not a dependency on /private/tmp.
runtime_setup.no_live_app_dependency: The old /private/tmp native application checkout is not modified. Its preinstalled runtime dependencies were reused only to avoid a package framework.
